# Expected outcome (drop or keep), a tab, then a prompt that mixes scripts. Invented data only.
drop	Please translate this address for me: Ольга Смирнова, ул. Ленина, д. 12, кв. 5, Казань
drop	Меня зовут Ольга Смирнова, ул. Ленина, д. 12. Please reply in English, thanks a lot.
drop	Can you check this sentence for me: 東京都新宿区西新宿2丁目8番1号に住んでいます。
drop	Translate the word привет into English, please, for my class.
drop	My friend Иванов wrote this, can you fix it?
keep	I am writing an essay about the history of greetings across Europe and the way the Russian word привет is used between close friends, family members and colleagues in informal settings every day.
keep	Explain how the Chinese word 你好 is used in greetings.
keep	Why does the Korean word 안녕하세요 sound so polite to learners?
